unit.metreOrMinute.meaning: The intentionally shared lowercase notation for a metre or a minute. Multiple valid interpretations can produce multiple answers to one expression.
unit.metreOrMinute.context: Lazy resolution uses constraints across the expression. Multiple valid interpretations produce possible answers. Display identical-looking formatted answers once, without captions, while preserving every underlying interpretation and exact value. For example, 2m * 2 displays one 4m; 10m / 2s displays 5m/s and 300. Independent occurrences may resolve differently. Filtering unsupported alternatives, ordering and copy selection remain open. Do not silently truncate the set of distinct visible answers.
unit.metreOrMinute.location: Unit positions in expressions and results, including nested quantities. The chosen result layout is a horizontally scrolling row without interpretation captions. Completion descriptions are retained separately.
